{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' And he's using the Nalle Triplets as a distraction to skim credits from the Toydarian|Drake Lo'gaan's thoughts on a Jokhali gambler.|<ref name="Evasive">''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]''</ref>}}
The '''Nalle triplets''', also known as the '''Nalle sisters''', were a trio of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|sisters]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The sisters were [[Mya Nalle]], [[Yma Nalle]], and [[Lela Nalle Mayn]], who hailed from the planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. They worked as [[Spy/Legends|spies]] for the corrupt [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Acros-Krik]] and frequently visited the [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] of the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]], where they utilized their femininity to steal [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], all three spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at Coruscant's [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]].

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Jokhali|Jokhali]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] used the triplets to skim credits off a [[Unidentified Toydarian (Outlander Club)|Toydarian]] in a game of [[Divot/Legends|divot]] at the Outlander Club. When the underage participant [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan's]] age was realized, Yma and Mya pulled the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from the table. The [[Jokhalli|Jokhali]] planned on shooting the teenager, but he was able to escape the club.

==Description==
The Nalle triplets,<ref name="CSWE" /> or the Nalle sisters, comprised of [[Mya Nalle]], [[Yma Nalle]] and [[Lela Nalle Mayn]],<ref name="Insider" /> a trio of identical<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Insider" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] sisters who lived on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The only [[Marriage/Legends|married]] triplet, Mayn, was an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] and native of the<ref name="Insider" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &#x2014; Based on corresponding data for [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]]</ref> planet [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="Insider" />

==History==
===Triplet spies===
At some point before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Mayn came to the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]] to study architecture.<ref name="Insider" /> The triplets worked as subtly effective<ref name="db" /> [[Spy/Legends|spies]] for corrupt [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Acros-Krik]],<ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|lelamayn|Mayn, Lela Nalle}}</ref> who offered them as guides to targets he wanted monitored. They reported to the mayor any useful information their guests foolishly divulged.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|acros_krik|Acros-Krik}}</ref> The triplets, who were considered attractive,<ref name="db" /> commonly went to the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] halls and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant, where they used their femininity to distract other gamblers while stealing their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Mayn unfortunately found herself studying the architecture of establishments like the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Insider" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and gambling hall in the Uscru District.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref>

In 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the triplets visited the Outlander on the [[Local day/Legends|night]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] escaped into the club after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Mya and Yma accompanied themselves with fellow Humans at the club's<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] lounge<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> while Mayn walked and talked with another Human. Mayn and her companion walked by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were in the club searching for Wesell.<ref name="AOTC" />

===Bedtime for Lo'gaan===
{{Quote|Isn't it past your bedtime, cutey?|Mya or Yma Nalle, to Drake Lo'gaan|<ref name="Evasive" />}}
Shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Hyperspace">{{InsiderCite|85|Best of Hyperspace}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NECRotS">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the triplets were at the Outlander Club, accompanying a [[Unidentified Jokhali|Jokhali]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] participating in a game of [[Divot/Legends|divot]] with the Jedi fugitive [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]], a [[Undentified Toydarian (Outlander Club)|Toydarian]], and a Human. The [[Jokhalli|Jokhali]] was using the women as a distraction to skim [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] of off the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]], which Lo'gaan mentally noted. When the Human at the divot table realized Lo'gaan was underage, Mya and Yma pulled the teenager from the table, with one of the two jokingly asking if him if it was past his [[Time/Legends|bedtime]]. The Jokhali then planned on shooting Lo'gaan, but was body-slammed by Lo'gaan's Jedi ally [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]]. The Jedi preceded to escape the nightclub.<ref name="Evasive" />

Mayn eventually had<ref name="Insider" /> a Human<ref name="Solo">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> daughter named [[Todra Mayn]],<ref name="Insider" /> who hailed from Commenor<ref name="Solo" /> like her mother.<ref name="Insider" /> Todra served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as the leader of [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|hunt]] for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]<ref name="Solo" /> and later the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nalle triplets first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Uncredited<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> actor [[Amy Allen]] portrayed all three members of the family due to [[Industrial Light & Magic]] composing her in<ref name="Insider" /> multiple times in the film.<ref name="AOTC" /> Two of the sisters were first pictured in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]'', written by [[Marcus Hearn]]<ref name="Illustrated Companion">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''</ref> and released on [[April 22]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Attack-Clones-Illustrated/dp/0091884780|text=Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion}}</ref> The group was first identified as the Nalle sisters<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> with the publication of "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," an article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''.<ref name="Insider" /> They were then identified as the Nalle triplets with the ''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]'' webstrips, written by [[Paul Ens]] and published daily between [[August]] [[2005]] and [[December]] [[2005]].<ref name="Recruitment announcement">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20050729.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=The Space Battle on Paper}}</ref>
